Library Comfort Scale

Instructions:  Below are several descriptions of how you feel in libraries. Please use the scale below to rate the degree to which each statement applies to you.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. I feel at ease in a library.

_____2. I feel calm when I walk among the shelves.

_____3. I do not feel welcome in a library.

_____4. I feel completely at ease among the library shelves.

_____5. Libraries make me tense.

_____6. I am relaxed when I study in a library.

Recode items 3, 4, and 5

Scores should range between 6 and 30.
